description: Find surf towns by name/country text, region, month with good surf, surfer level and wave type. All filters are optional; results are ranked most popular first (popularity.rank 1 = best known: Wikipedia readership, places to stay and surf spots) and include best months, water temperature, number of curated surf spots and a page URL. With a month, the towns are ranked by how good that month's surf measured over the last three years (good + great days) and each has inMonth: goodDays and greatDays (% of days rated Good or better, Great or better, at the town's best spot), seaTempC and waveHeightM (null where not measured yet).

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. "Portugal" or "PT". Each town also has a zone (e.g. "Lisbon coast", "Canary Islands").

include_towns_without_spots.description: By default only towns with curated surf spots (the ones listed on swellcabin.com) are returned.

month.description: Only towns whose best season includes this month (1 = January).

query.description: Free text: town, country, area or region, e.g. "portugal" or "bali".

name: search_towns
title: Search surf towns
